questions.content:
一.（34分）将重物架在两圆柱上，当两圆柱静止时，使重物克服摩擦力沿圆柱轴向滑动（拉出）是较困难的，但若使圆柱按图示方向旋转，再使重物作同样的滑动将容易得多。然而，若圆柱旋转方向与图示方向相反，则使重物滑动将更难，甚至有可能产生“自锁”（无论施加多大拉力也无法拉动重物）。本题将从力学角度来讨论这一问题。设重物质量为 $m$，它左右对称地架在同一水平面上的两平行圆柱上，两圆柱半径均为 $r$，绕轴旋转角速度大小均为 $\omega$，A、B 为重物与圆柱的切点，A、B 与圆柱轴心的连线与竖直方向的夹角均为 $\alpha$，重物与两圆柱间的摩擦系数均为 $\mu$。

（1）若两圆柱按图示方向旋转，求将重物沿圆柱轴向以匀速 $v_0$ 向外拉时，所需拉力 $F$ 的表达式。[18分]

（2）若两圆柱旋转方向与图中所示相反，求使重物做同样运动所需拉力 $F$ 的表达式，讨论产生“自锁”的可能性。[16分]

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-1.png)
questions.analysis:
（1）$\vec{v}' = v_0 \vec{k} - r\omega\cos\alpha \vec{i} - r\omega\sin\alpha \vec{j}$

$$\bar{f} = -f \frac{\vec{v}'}{v'} = -\mu N \frac{\vec{v}'}{v'}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-1.png)

$$\frac{\mu N}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\left(r\omega\cos\alpha\vec{i}+r\omega\sin\alpha\vec{j}-v_0\vec{k}\right)$$

$$f_y = \frac{r\omega\sin\alpha}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N$$

$$f_z = -\frac{v_0}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-2.png)

$$2N\cos\alpha = mg - 2f_y = mg - \frac{2r\omega\sin\alpha}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N$$

$$N = \frac{mg\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}{2(\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}+\mu r\omega\sin\alpha)}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-3.png)

$$f_z = -\frac{\mu mgv_0}{2\left(\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}+\mu r\omega\sin\alpha\right)}$$

$$F + 2f_z = 0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-4.png)

$$F = -2f_z = \frac{\mu mgv_0}{\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}+\mu r\omega\sin\alpha}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-5.png)

$$f_y = \frac{r\omega\sin\alpha}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N,\quad f_z = -\frac{v_0}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N$$

（2）假设物块能滑动，同理可求：

$$N = \frac{mg\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}{2(\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}-\mu r\omega\sin\alpha)}$$

$$F = \frac{\mu mgv_0}{\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}-\mu r\omega\sin\alpha}$$

条件：$\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2} > \mu r\omega\sin\alpha$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-6.png)

$$\mu\tan\alpha < \sqrt{1+\frac{v_0^2}{r^2\omega^2}}$$

$$\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2} \leq \mu r\omega\sin\alpha$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-7.png)

$$\mu\tan\alpha \geq \sqrt{1+\frac{v_0^2}{r^2\omega^2}}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-8.png)

$N < 0$，$F < 0$ 或 $N \to \infty$，$F \to \infty$ 无意义，不能滑动，产生自锁。
questions.answer:
（1）$F = \dfrac{\mu mgv_0}{\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}+\mu r\omega\sin\alpha}$

（2）$F = \dfrac{\mu mgv_0}{\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}-\mu r\omega\sin\alpha}$；当 $\mu\tan\alpha \geq \sqrt{1+\dfrac{v_0^2}{r^2\omega^2}}$ 时产生自锁。

questions.content:
二.（42分）如图所示，半径为R的光滑半球面固定在水平地面上，长度为 $L = \pi R / 3$ ，总质量为m的匀质柔软链条置于球面上，初始链条保持静止，其左端刚好位于球面最高处。从静止开始释放链条。

(1)刚释放时，链条的加速度大小是多少？[8分]

(2)刚释放时，链条上什么位置张力最大，最大张力是多少？[8分]

(3)假设链条左端绕球心O转过角度 $\varphi \cong 10^{\circ}$ 时，链条没有飞离球面，求此时链条下滑的速度和加速度；[8分]

(4) 求 $\varphi = 10^{\circ}$ 时链条对球面的作用力（求出合力即可）；[10分]

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-2.png)

(5)链条右端着地之前，链条是否会部分脱离球面？如果会，求出脱离时链条左端绕球心O转过的角度 $\varphi_c$；如果不会，请说明理由[8分]。
questions.analysis:
(1) $\lambda = \frac{m}{L} = \frac{3}{\pi} \frac{m}{R}$
$$\mathrm{d}T + \lambda R g \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \lambda R a \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\int_0^0 \mathrm{d}T + \lambda R g \int_0^{\pi/3} \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \lambda R a \int_0^{\pi/3} \mathrm{d}\theta$$
![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-9.png)
$$\frac{1}{2} \lambda R g = \frac{\pi}{3} \lambda R a$$
$$a = \frac{3}{2\pi} g$$
另解：
$$\mathrm{d}M = \mathrm{d}m g \cdot R\sin\theta = \lambda g R\mathrm{d}\theta \cdot R\sin\theta = \lambda g R^2 \sin\theta \mathrm{d}\theta \quad (\lambda = \frac{m}{l} = \frac{3}{\pi} \frac{m}{R})$$
$$M = \int_0^{\pi/3} \lambda g R^2 \sin\theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \frac{1}{2} \lambda g R^2$$
$$\frac{1}{3} \pi \lambda R^2 v, \quad \frac{\mathrm{d}L}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{1}{3} \pi \lambda R^2 a$$
![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-10.png)
$$\frac{\mathrm{d}L}{\mathrm{d}t} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{2} \lambda g R^2 = \frac{1}{3} \pi \lambda R^2 a$$
$$a = \frac{3}{2\pi} g$$
(2)
$$\int_0^T \mathrm{d}T + \lambda R g \int_0^\theta \sin\theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \lambda R a \int_0^\theta \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$T = \lambda R a \theta - \lambda R g (1 - \cos\theta) = \lambda R g \left( \frac{3}{2\pi} \theta + \cos\theta - 1 \right)$$
![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-11.png)
$$\frac{\mathrm{d}T}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = \lambda R g \left( \frac{3}{2\pi} - \sin\theta \right)$$
$$\left. \frac{\mathrm{d}T}{\mathrm{d}\theta} \right|_{\theta=\theta_m} = 0 \Rightarrow \sin\theta_m = \frac{3}{2\pi}, \quad \cos\theta_m = \sqrt{1 - \frac{9}{4\pi^2}}, \quad \theta_m \approx 0.498 \text{ rad}$$
$$T_{\max} = \lambda R g \left( \frac{3}{2\pi} \theta_m + \cos\theta_m - 1 \right) = \frac{3}{\pi} m g \left( \frac{3}{2\pi} \theta_m + \cos\theta_m - 1 \right) \approx 0.111 m g$$
根据角动量定理也可解。
$$\mathrm{d}T + \lambda R g \sin\theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \lambda R a \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$a = \frac{3}{2\pi} g, \quad \lambda = \frac{3}{\pi} \frac{m}{R}$$
(3) 质心位置：
$$R_c = \frac{\int R\cos\theta \mathrm{d}m}{m} = \frac{\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6} R\cos\theta \cdot \lambda R \mathrm{d}\theta}{\lambda (\pi R/3)} = \frac{3R}{\pi}$$
$$m g R_c \cos\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{2} m v^2 + m g R_c \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$$
![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-12.png)
$$v = \sqrt{\frac{6gR}{\pi}} \left[ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \right] \approx 0.437\sqrt{gR}$$
$$a_t = \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}\varphi} \frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{v}{R} \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}\varphi} = \frac{1}{2R} \frac{\mathrm{d}v^2}{\mathrm{d}\varphi} = \frac{3g}{\pi} \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \approx 0.614g$$
![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-13.png)
![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-14.png)
另解：
$$\mathrm{d}T + \mathrm{d}m g \sin\theta = \mathrm{d}m a_t$$
$$\int_\Omega \mathrm{d}m = \lambda R \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\mathrm{d}T + \lambda R g \sin\theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \lambda R a_t \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\int_0^0 \mathrm{d}T + \lambda R g \int_\varphi^{\varphi+\pi/3} \sin\theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \lambda R a_t \int_\varphi^{\varphi+\pi/3} \mathrm{d}\theta$$
![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-15.png)
$$a_t = \frac{3g}{\pi} \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \approx 0.614g$$
$$a_t = \frac{3g}{\pi} \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}\varphi} \frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{v}{R} \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}\varphi}$$
$$v \mathrm{d}v = \frac{3gR}{\pi} \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \mathrm{d}\varphi, \quad \int_0^v v \mathrm{d}v = \frac{3gR}{\pi} \int_0^\varphi \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \mathrm{d}\varphi$$
$$v = \sqrt{\frac{6gR}{\pi}} \left[ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \right] \approx 0.437\sqrt{gR}$$
(4)
$$\omega = \frac{v}{R}, \quad \beta = \frac{a_t}{R}$$
$$v^2 = \frac{6gR}{\pi} \left[ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \right]$$
$$a_{Ct} = R_c \beta = R_c \frac{a_t}{R} = \frac{9g}{\pi^2} \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$$
$$a_t = \frac{3g}{\pi} \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right), \quad R_c = \frac{3R}{\pi}$$
$$a_{Cn} = R_c \omega^2 = R_c \left(\frac{v}{R}\right)^2 = \frac{18g}{\pi^2} \left[ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \right]$$
$$N_t + m g \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = m a_{Ct} = \frac{9mg}{\pi^2} \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$$
![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-16.png)
$$m g \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) + N_n = m a_{Cn} = \frac{18mg}{\pi^2} \left[ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \right]$$
$$N_t = m g \left( \frac{9}{\pi^2} - 1 \right) \sin\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \approx -0.056mg$$
$$N = \sqrt{N_t^2 + N_n^2}$$
$$N_n = -m g \left[ \left( \frac{18}{\pi^2} + 1 \right) \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) - \frac{9\sqrt{3}}{\pi^2} \right] \approx -0.584mg$$
$$N \approx 0.586mg$$
(5)
$$\int \mathrm{d}m g \cos\theta + T \mathrm{d}\theta - \mathrm{d}N = \int \mathrm{d}m \frac{v^2}{R}$$
$$\mathrm{d}m = \lambda R \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\mathrm{d}N = \left( \lambda g R \cos\theta - \lambda v^2 + T \right) \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\mathrm{d}N_{\min} = \left[ \lambda g R \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) - \lambda v^2 \right] \mathrm{d}\theta$$
![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-17.png)
$$\mathrm{d}N_{\min} = \lambda R g \left[ \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) + \frac{6}{\pi} \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) - \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{\pi} \right] \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\mathrm{d}N_{\min}\big|_{\varphi=\varphi_c} = 0 \Rightarrow \cos\left(\varphi_c + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) + \frac{6}{\pi} \cos\left(\varphi_c + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{\pi}$$
$$\varphi_c \approx 0.242 \text{ rad} \approx 13.9^\circ$$
$$v^2 = \frac{6gR}{\pi} \left[ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \right]$$
questions.answer:
(1) $a = \frac{3}{2\pi} g$

(2) 张力最大位置 $\theta_m \approx 0.498 \text{ rad}$，最大张力 $T_{\max} \approx 0.111 m g$

(3) $v \approx 0.437\sqrt{gR}$，$a_t \approx 0.614g$

(4) 链条对球面的作用力 $N \approx 0.586mg$

(5) 会部分脱离球面，脱离角 $\varphi_c \approx 0.242 \text{ rad} \approx 13.9^\circ$

questions.content:
三（42分）如图，六根质量均为 $m$、长度均为 $l$ 的匀质刚性杆光滑铰接构成一个正六边形。初始时正六边形位于竖直面内，其最下方的 $AB$ 杆恰好水平并距地面 $2l$。正六边形由静止释放并与地面发生完全非弹性碰撞。已知重力加速度为 $g$。试求：

（1）$AB$ 杆触地后瞬间 $BC$ 杆转动的角速度；[14分]

（2）$AB$ 杆触地后瞬间 $BC$ 杆转动的角加速度；[14分]

（3）$BC$ 杆运动到水平位置（但未与地面发生碰撞）时的角速度。[14分]

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-3.png)
questions.analysis:
题三。

(1) $v_0=2\sqrt{gl}$

$$\left\{ I_{1x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{2}-I_{1y}\frac{l}{2}=-\frac{1}{3}ml^2\omega+mv_0\frac{l}{4} \right\}$$

$$I_{1x}+I_{2x}=mv_{Cx}$$

$$I_{1y}-I_{2y}=-mv_{Cy}+mv_0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-18.png)

$$\left[ I_{1y}\frac{l}{4}+I_{1x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{4}-I_{2x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{4}+I_{2y}\frac{l}{4}=\frac{1}{12}ml^2\omega \right]$$

$$\therefore I_{2y}=-mv_2+mv_0$$

$$6v_2=18v_0-3\sqrt{3}v_{Cx}-9v_{Cy}-5l\omega$$

$$v_1=l\omega$$

$$v_2\cos30^\circ=v_1\cos30^\circ$$

$$v_2=v_1=l\omega \quad (2)$$

$$v_{Cx}=\frac{1}{2}v_1\cos30^\circ=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}l\omega$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-19.png)

$$v_{Cy}=\frac{1}{2}\left(v_1\sin30^\circ+v_2\right)=\frac{3}{4}l\omega$$

$(1)\sim(4)\Rightarrow$

$$\omega=\frac{9}{10}\frac{v_0}{l}=\frac{9}{5}\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}}$$

$$6v_2=18v_0-3\sqrt{3}v_0=9\sqrt{3}-5l\omega$$

$$a_{1n}=l\omega^2$$

$$a_1=l\beta$$

$$a_2\cos30^\circ-a_{1n}\cos60^\circ-a_{1t}\cos30^\circ=l\omega^2$$

$$a_2=l\beta+\sqrt{3}l\omega^2$$

$$a_{Cx}=\frac{1}{2}(a_{1t}\cos30^\circ-a_{1n}\cos60^\circ)=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}l\beta-\frac{1}{4}l\omega^2$$

$$a_{Cy}=\frac{1}{2}(a_{1t}\cos60^\circ+a_{1n}\cos30^\circ+a_2)=\frac{3}{4}l\beta+\frac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}l\omega^2$$

$(5)\sim(8)\Rightarrow$

$$\beta=\frac{9}{10}\frac{g}{l}-\frac{3\sqrt{3}}{5}l\omega^2=\left(\frac{9}{10}-\frac{243\sqrt{3}}{125}\right)\frac{g}{l}\approx-2.47\frac{g}{l}$$

$$6a_2=18g-3\sqrt{3}a_{Cx}-9a_{Cy}-5l\beta \quad (5), \quad \omega=\frac{9}{5}\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}}$$

$$E_{\mathrm{k}}+E_{\mathrm{p}}=E_{\mathrm{kf}}+E_{\mathrm{pf}}\tag{5}$$

$$\frac{27}{5}mgl+3\sqrt{3}mgl=\frac{14}{3}ml^2\omega_f^2+0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-20.png)

$$\sqrt{\left(\frac{81}{70}+\frac{9\sqrt{3}}{14}\right)\frac{g}{l}}\approx1.51\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}}$$

$$E_{\mathrm{k}}=\frac{27}{5}mgl, E_{\mathrm{p}}=3\sqrt{3}mgl, E_{\mathrm{kf}}=\frac{14}{3}ml^2\omega_{\mathrm{f}}^2, E_{\mathrm{pf}}=0$$

(2)

$$\left\{ F_{1x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{2}-F_{1y}\frac{l}{2}-mg\frac{l}{4}=-\frac{1}{3}ml^2\beta \right\}$$

$$F_{1x}+F_{2x}=ma_{Cx}$$

$$F_{1y}-F_{2y}-mg=-ma_{Cy}$$

$$\left| F_{1y}\frac{l}{4}+F_{1x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{4}-F_{2x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{4}+F_{2y}\frac{l}{4} \right|=\frac{1}{12}ml\beta$$

（1）求整个导体所带的总电量；[16分]

questions.analysis:
（1）在 $O$ 放一点电荷 $q_1$：左球面等电势：$\frac{q_1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_1}$；右球面不等电势；

在 $P$ 放一点电荷 $q'$，满足：$q'=-\frac{R_2}{d}q_1$，$d_2=\frac{R_2^2}{d}$，右球面等电势：0；左球面不等电势；

在 $O_2$ 放一点电荷 $q_2$，满足 $q'=-\frac{R_1}{d}q_2$（$q_2=-\frac{d}{R_1}q'$），$d_1=\frac{R_1^2}{d}$。

左球面等电势：$U_{\text{左}}=\frac{q_1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_1}$；右球面等电势：$U_{\text{右}}=\frac{q_2'}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_2}=\frac{q_1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_1}$。

$$U=\frac{q_1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_1}=\frac{q_2}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_2}$$

$$q_1=4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_1 U,\quad q_2=4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_2 U$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-23.png)

$$q'=-\frac{R_2}{d}q_1=-\frac{4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_1 R_2 U}{d}=-\frac{4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_1 R_2 U}{\sqrt{R_1^2+R_2^2}}\quad\left(d=\sqrt{R_1^2+R_2^2}\right)$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-24.png)

$$Q=q_1+q_2+q'=4\pi\varepsilon_0 U\left(R_1+R_2-\frac{R_1 R_2}{\sqrt{R_1^2+R_2^2}}\right)$$

（2）$\sigma=\varepsilon_0 E_n$，$r_2^2=R_1^2+d^2+2R_1 d\cos\theta$，$r'^2=R_1^2+d_1^2+2R_1 d_1\cos\theta=\frac{R_1^2}{d^2}r_2^2$。

$$\cos\alpha=\frac{R_1^2+r_2^2-d^2}{2R_1 r_2}=\frac{R_1+d\cos\theta}{r_2},\quad \cos\beta=\frac{R_1^2+r'^2-d_1^2}{2R_1 r'}=\frac{d+R_1\cos\theta}{r_2}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-25.png)

$$E_1=\frac{q_1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 R_1^2}=\frac{U}{R_1},\quad E_2=\frac{q_2}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 r_2^2}=\frac{R_2 U}{r_2^2},\quad E'=\frac{|q'|}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 r'^2}=\frac{R_1 R_2 U}{r'^2}=\frac{R_2 U}{R_1 r_2^2}$$

$$E_n=E_1+E_2\cos\alpha-E'\cos\beta=\cdots=\frac{U}{R_1}\left(1-\frac{R_2^3}{r_2^3}\right)\quad\left(d=\sqrt{R_1^2+R_2^2}\right)$$

$$E_n=\frac{U}{R_1}\left[1-\frac{R_2^3}{\left(R_1^2+d^2+2R_1 d\cos\theta\right)^{3/2}}\right]$$

$$\sigma=\varepsilon_0 E_n=\frac{\varepsilon_0 U}{R_1}\left[1-\frac{R_2^3}{\left(R_1^2+d^2+2R_1 d\cos\theta\right)^{3/2}}\right]$$

另解：

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-26.png)

$$\Phi_s=\frac{2\pi r^2(1-\cos\theta)}{4\pi r^2}\frac{Q}{\varepsilon_0}=\frac{1}{2}(1-\cos\theta)\frac{Q}{\varepsilon_0}$$

$$r_2^2=R_1^2+d^2+2R_1 d\cos\theta,\quad r'^2=R_1^2+d_1^2+2R_1 d_1\cos\theta=\frac{R_1^2}{d^2}r_2^2$$

$$\cos\alpha=\frac{d^2+r_2^2-R_1^2}{2dr_2}=\frac{d-R_1\cos\theta}{r_2},\quad \cos\beta=\frac{d_1^2+r'^2-R_1^2}{2dr'}=\frac{R_1-d\cos\theta}{r_2}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-27.png)

$$\Phi_e=\frac{1}{2}(1-\cos\theta)\frac{q_1}{\varepsilon_0}+\frac{1}{2}(1-\cos\alpha)\frac{q_2}{\varepsilon_0}+\frac{1}{2}(1-\cos\beta)\frac{q'}{\varepsilon_0}$$

$$2\pi U\left[R_1+R_2-\frac{R_1 R_2}{d}-R_1\cos\theta-\frac{R_2^3}{d\sqrt{R_1^2+d^2+2R_1 d\cos\theta}}\right]$$

$$\sum q=\varepsilon_0\Phi_s$$

$$2\pi\varepsilon_0 U\left[R_1+R_2-\frac{R_1 R_2}{d}-R_1\cos\theta-\frac{R_2^3}{d\sqrt{R_1^2+d^2+2R_1 d\cos\theta}}\right]$$

$$\mathrm{d}q=2\pi\varepsilon_0 U R_1\sin\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\left[1-\frac{R_2^3}{\left(R_1^2+d^2+2R_1 d\cos\theta\right)^{3/2}}\right]$$

$$\mathrm{d}S=2\pi R_1^2\sin\theta\mathrm{d}\theta,\quad \sigma=\frac{\mathrm{d}q}{\mathrm{d}S}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-28.png)

$$\frac{\varepsilon_0 U}{R_1}\left[1-\frac{R_2^3}{\left(R_1^2+d^2+2R_1 d\cos\theta\right)^{3/2}}\right]$$

（3）$R_1=R_2\equiv R$，$d=\sqrt{2}R$。

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-29.png)

$$E=E_n=\frac{U}{R}\left[1-\frac{1}{\left(3+2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta\right)^{3/2}}\right]$$

$$f=\frac{1}{2}\varepsilon_0 E^2=\frac{\varepsilon_0 U^2}{2R^2}\left[1-\frac{1}{\left(3+2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta\right)^{3/2}}\right]^2$$

$$\mathrm{d}F=f\mathrm{d}S\cdot\cos\theta=f\cdot 2\pi R^2\sin\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\cdot\cos\theta$$

$$F=\int_0^{3\pi/4}\pi\varepsilon_0 U^2\left[1-\frac{1}{\left(3+2\sqrt{2}\cos\theta\right)^{3/2}}\right]^2\cos\theta\sin\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta$$

$$=-\pi\varepsilon_0 U^2\int_1^{-\sqrt{2}/2}\left[1-\frac{1}{\left(3+2\sqrt{2}x\right)^{3/2}}\right]^2 x\,\mathrm{d}x=(6-4\sqrt{2})\pi\varepsilon_0 U^2$$

五.（42分）如图所示是一个简化的电子透镜模型。一个导线圆环，半径为R，通有沿图示方向的恒定电流，电流强度大小为I。以圆环中心为原点，圆环轴向为z轴建立图示的柱坐标系。电子发射器位于z轴上z=-s处 $(s>>R)$，发射的电子的初速度大小均为 $v_0$，方向可能不同，但与z轴的夹角都很小。用柱坐标 $(r,\theta,z)$ 表示电子在空间的位置。假设电子在运动过程中轴向速度远大于角向速度和径向速度，即 $|v_z|>>|v_r|$，$|v_z|>>|v_\theta|$。已知电子电量为-e，质量为m，不考虑相对论效应。其径向坐标 $r \ll R$。

(1) 求圆环在电子所在位置 $(r,\theta,z)$ 产生的磁感应强度；
(2) 求当电子的位置坐标为 $(r,\theta,z)$ 时，电子绕z轴的角速度 $\omega=d\theta/dt$；
(3) 假设电子穿过电流环时，其径向坐标为r，且在临近电流环的区域（磁力作用不可忽略的区域），径向坐标变化很小，可近似认为是一个常量。试计算电子通过电流环的磁场时径向（方向）动量的改变量。

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-4.png)
questions.analysis:
(1) $B_\theta=0$

$$B_z \approx \frac{\mu_0 I R^2}{2(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}}$$

$$\oint_S \vec{B}\cdot d\vec{S}=0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-31.png)

$$(B_z+dB_z)\cdot\pi r^2 - B_z\cdot\pi r^2 + B_r\cdot 2\pi r dz=0$$

$$B_r = -\frac{r}{2}\frac{dB_z}{dz} = \frac{3\mu_0 I R^2 r z}{4(z^2+R^2)^{5/2}}$$

$$\vec{B}=B_z\vec{e}_z+B_r\vec{e}_r$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-32.png)

$$\frac{\mu_0 I R^2}{2(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}}\left(\vec{e}_z+\frac{3rz}{2z^2+2R^2}\vec{e}_r\right)$$

(2)

$$\vec{B}=B_z\vec{e}_z+B_r\vec{e}_r, \vec{v}=v_z\vec{e}_z+v_r\vec{e}_r+v_\theta\vec{e}_\theta$$

$$\vec{F}=-e\vec{v}\times\vec{B}=eB_r v_\theta\vec{e}_z - eB_z v_\theta\vec{e}_r + (eB_z v_r - eB_r v_z)\vec{e}_\theta$$

$$F_\theta = eB_z v_r - eB_r v_z = m\left(r\frac{d^2\theta}{dt^2}+2\frac{dr}{dt}\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right)$$

$$eB_z v_r - eB_r v_z = eB_z\frac{dr}{dt} + \frac{er}{2}\frac{dB_z}{dz}\frac{dz}{dt} = eB_z\frac{dr}{dt} + \frac{er}{2}\frac{dB_z}{dt} = \frac{e}{2r}\frac{d}{dt}(r^2 B_z)$$

$$m\left(r\frac{d^2\theta}{dt^2}+2\frac{dr}{dt}\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right) = \frac{m}{r}\frac{d}{dt}\left(r^2\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right)$$

$$\frac{e}{2r}\frac{d}{dt}(r^2 B_z) = \frac{m}{r}\frac{d}{dt}\left(r^2\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right)$$

$$\frac{e}{2}d(r^2 B_z) = m d(r^2\dot{\theta}) \quad (\dot{\theta}=\frac{d\theta}{dt})$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-33.png)

$$B_r = -\frac{r}{2}\frac{dB_z}{dz}$$

$$\frac{d\theta}{dt}=\dot{\theta}=\frac{e}{2m}B_z=\frac{\mu_0 e I R^2}{4m(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-34.png)

$$\frac{e}{2}d(r^2 B_z) = m d\left(r^2\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right), B_z=\frac{\mu_0 I R^2}{2(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}}$$

$$\frac{e}{2}\int_0^{r^2 B_z} d(r^2 B_z) = m\int_0^{r^2\dot{\theta}} d(r^2\dot{\theta})$$

$$\frac{e}{2}r^2 B_z = m r^2\dot{\theta}$$

$$F_r = m a_r = m\left[\frac{dv_r}{dt}-r\left(\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right)^2\right]$$

(3)

$$dp_r = \frac{dp_r}{dt}dt - m r\left(\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right)^2 dt$$

$$\frac{dp_r}{dt}=F_r+mr\left(\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right)^2$$

$$-e v_\theta B_z + m r\left(\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right)^2 = -e r\frac{d\theta}{dt}B_z + m r\left(\frac{d\theta}{dt}\right)^2 = -\frac{e^2 r B_z^2}{4m}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-35.png)

$$dp_r = -\frac{e^2 r B_z^2}{4m}dt \approx -\frac{e^2 r B_z^2}{4m}\frac{dz}{v_0} = -\frac{\mu_0^2 e^2 r I^2 R^4}{16m v_0}\frac{dz}{(z^2+R^2)^3}$$

$$\vec{F}=eB_r v_\theta\vec{e}_z - eB_z v_\theta\vec{e}_r + (eB_z v_r - eB_r v_z)\vec{e}_\theta, B_z=\frac{\mu_0 I R^2}{2(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}}, \frac{d\theta}{dt}=\frac{eB_z}{2m}$$

$$\Delta p_r = -\frac{\mu_0^2 e^2 I^2 r R^4}{16m v_0}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{dz}{(z^2+R^2)^3} = -\frac{3\pi\mu_0^2 e^2 I^2 r}{128m v_0 R}$$

(4)

$$p_r = p_0\sin\alpha \approx m v_0\frac{r}{s}$$

$$p_r' = -p_0\sin\beta \approx -m v_0\frac{r}{s'}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-36.png)

$$\Delta p_r = p_r' - p_r \approx -m v_0 r\left(\frac{1}{s}+\frac{1}{s'}\right)$$

$$\frac{1}{s}+\frac{1}{s'} = -\frac{\Delta p_r}{m v_0 r} = \frac{3\pi}{128R}\left(\frac{\mu_0 e I}{m v_0}\right)^2$$

$$\frac{1}{s}+\frac{1}{s'}=\frac{1}{f}$$

与薄透镜成像公式相同！

$$f = \frac{128}{3\pi}R\left(\frac{m v_0}{\mu_0 e I}\right)^2$$

questions.content:
七.（38分）光阑是指在光学系统中对光束起着限制作用的实体。它可以是透镜的边缘、框架或特别设置的带孔屏。如图在空间中有两个相距为2f、直径为D，焦距为-f的凹透镜，在它们之间有一个焦距为f、直径为2D的凸透镜，三者共轴放置。在第二个凹透镜之后距离为d=f处有一个光屏。用平行于光轴的平行光照射左边的凹透镜 $L_1$，已知入射光刚好充满 $L_1$，光强为 $I_0$。现移动凸透镜 $L_2$，用x表示透镜 $L_2$ 与 $L_1$ 之间的距离，且 $0<x<2f$。若未通过透镜的光均被完全遮挡，试讨论光屏上的光斑大小和光强与x的关系。

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-6.png)
questions.analysis:
（1）$x=f$

光刚好覆盖透镜 $L_2$；光刚好覆盖透镜 $L_3$；光屏上光斑直径为：

$$D_3=D$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-41.png)

光强：

$$I=I_0$$

（2）$0<x<f$

$$s_1=f$$

$$\frac{D_1}{D_2}=\frac{f+x}{f}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-42.png)

$$D_1=\frac{f+x}{f}D<2D$$

$$\frac{1}{s_2}-\frac{1}{-f-x}=\frac{1}{f}$$

$$s_2=\frac{f(f+x)}{x}$$

$$\frac{D_2}{D_1}=\frac{s_2-2f+x}{s_2}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-43.png)

$$D_2=\frac{s_2-2f+x}{s_2}D_1=\frac{f^2-x(f-x)}{f^2}D<D$$

$$\frac{-s_3-\frac{1}{s_2-2f+x}}{-f}=\frac{1}{-f}$$

$$s_3=\frac{x^2-fx+f^2}{(x-f)^2}f$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-44.png)

$$D_3=\frac{f+s_3}{s_3}D_2$$

$$D_3=\frac{2f^2-3fx+2x^2}{f^2}D \quad (0\leq x\leq f)$$

$$I=\frac{I_0\cdot\pi(D/2)^2}{\pi(D_3/2)^2}=\frac{f^2}{2x^2-3fx+2f^2}I_0 \quad (0\leq x\leq f)$$

$$s_2=\frac{f(x+f)}{x},D_2=\frac{x^2-fx+f^2}{f^2}D.$$

（3）$f<x\leq 2f$

$$D_1=\frac{f+x}{f}D>2D$$

$$\frac{D_2}{2D}=\frac{s_2-2f+x}{s_2}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-45.png)

$$D_2=\frac{2(f^2-fx+x^2)}{f(f+x)}D>D$$

$$\frac{D_3}{D}=\frac{f+s_3}{s_3}\Rightarrow D_3=\frac{2f^2-3fx+2x^2}{x^2-fx+f^2}D\quad(f<x\leq2f)$$

$$I=I_0\cdot\pi\left(\frac{D}{2}\right)^2\frac{(2D)^2}{D_1^2}\frac{1}{D_2^2}\frac{1}{\pi(D_3/2)^2}=\left(\frac{f^2}{2f^2-3fx+2x^2}\right)^2I_0$$

$$s_2=\frac{f(x+f)}{x},s_3=\frac{x^2-fx+f^2}{(x-f)^2}f$$

$$(f<x\leq 2f)$$

questions.content:
八.（42分）惯性系 S、S' 间相对运动关系如图示，S' 相对于 S 以速度 v 沿 x 轴方向作匀速运动，两坐标原点 O、O' 重合时，两参照系中的时间 t=t'=0。一静长度为 l_0，折射率为 n 的玻璃棒静止于 S' 系中，棒的一端与 O' 重合，棒身与 O'x' 轴的夹角为 θ_0。在 S' 系中 O' 处有一点光源，t'=0 时刻点光源发出一光脉冲，持续时间为 n l_0/c（c 为真空中的光速），该脉冲在玻璃棒内沿棒方向传播。试求：

(1) S 系测得，玻璃棒的长度和玻璃棒与 Ox 轴的夹角；[8分]

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-7.png)

(2) S 系测得，光脉冲在玻璃棒中的传播方向与 Ox 的夹角；[8分]

(3) S 系测得，玻璃棒被照亮的长度与时间 t 的关系。[26分]
questions.analysis:
(1)

$$l_x'=l_0\cos\theta_0,\quad l_y'=l_0\sin\theta_0$$

$$l_x=l_x'\sqrt{1-\beta^2}=l_0\cos\theta_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2}\quad\left(\beta=\frac{v}{c}\right)$$

$$l_y=l_y'=l_0\sin\theta_0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-46.png)

$$l=\sqrt{l_x^2+l_y^2}=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$$

$$\tan\theta=\frac{l_y}{l_x}=\frac{\tan\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}$$

(2)

$$u'=c/n$$

$$u_x'=\frac{c}{n}\cos\theta_0,\quad u_y'=\frac{c}{n}\sin\theta_0$$

$$u_x=\frac{u_x'+v}{1+u_x'v/c^2}=\frac{nv+c\cos\theta_0}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}c$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-47.png)

$$u_y=\frac{u_y'\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}{1+u_x'v/c^2}=\frac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{c^2-v^2}}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}c$$

$$\tan\theta_{\text{光}}=\frac{u_y}{u_x}=\frac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}{n\beta+\cos\theta_0}\quad\left(\beta=\frac{v}{c}\right)$$

(3) 阶段1：脉冲未停止发射，且光线未出玻璃棒。

$$S':\ x'=\frac{c}{n}t'\cos\theta_0,\quad y'=\frac{c}{n}t'\sin\theta_0$$

$$x=\frac{x'+vt'}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}=\frac{nv+c\cos\theta_0}{n\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}t'$$

$$y=y'=\frac{c}{n}t'\sin\theta_0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-48.png)

$$t=\frac{t'+vx'/c^2}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}=\frac{nc+v\cos\theta_0}{nc\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}t'$$

$$x=\frac{nv+c\cos\theta_0}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}ct$$

或：

$$x=u_xt=\frac{nv+c\cos\theta_0}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}ct$$

$$y=\frac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{c^2-v^2}}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}ct$$

$$y=u_yt=\frac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{c^2-v^2}}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}ct$$

$$d_{\text{光}}=\sqrt{(x-vt)^2+y^2}$$

$$=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-49.png)

$$x=\frac{nv+c\cos\theta_0}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}ct,\quad y=\frac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{c^2-v^2}}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}ct,\quad l=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$$

条件：

$$t'\leq nl_0/c$$

$$l_{\text{光}}\leq l$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-50.png)

$$t\leq\frac{n}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}\equiv t_{\text{停发}}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-51.png)

$$l_{\text{亮}}=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct,\quad l=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$$

阶段2：脉冲已停止发射，但光线未出玻璃棒。

$$t=t_{\text{停发}}=\frac{nl_0}{c\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}$$

$$l_{\text{亮}}=\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}nl_0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-52.png)

条件：$t_{\text{停发}}<t\leq t_{\text{出棒}}$

$$\frac{nl_0}{c\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}<t\leq\frac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}$$

$$l_{\text{亮}}=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct,\quad t_{\text{停发}}=\frac{n}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c},\quad t_{\text{出棒}}=\frac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c},\quad t_{\text{停发}}<t_{\text{出棒}}$$

阶段3：光线已出玻璃棒，但未离开玻璃棒

假想玻璃棒外的折射率与玻璃棒相同。

$$l=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$$

$$r=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-53.png)

$$l_s=\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}nl_0$$

假想光源持续发光

$$l_{\text{亮}}=l-(r-l_s)=\frac{\left[(2n+\beta\cos\theta_0)l_0-\sqrt{1-\beta^2}ct\right]\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}$$

$$l_{\text{亮}}=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}\quad\left(t\leq\frac{nl_0}{c\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\right)\quad l=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$$

$$l_{\text{亮}}=\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}nl_0=l_s\quad\left(\frac{nl_0^2}{c\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\right)\leq\frac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{c}l_0$$

阶段4：光线已离开玻璃棒

$$l_{\text{亮}}=0$$

条件：$t>t_{\text{离棒}}$

$$t>\frac{2n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-54.png)

$$t_{\text{离棒}}=\frac{2n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}$$

条件：$t>t_{\text{离棒}}$，且 $l_{\text{亮}}\geq0$

$$l_{\text{亮}}\geq0\Rightarrow t\leq\frac{2n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}\equiv t_{\text{离棒}}$$

$$\frac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}<t\leq\frac{2n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b5c67f1f/2021-兰阶-未标期次-第六套-答案-55.png)

$$t_{\text{离棒}}=\frac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}$$

$$l_{\text{亮}}=\frac{\left[(2n+\beta\cos\theta_0)l_0-\sqrt{1-\beta^2}ct\right]\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}\quad\left(t>\frac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}\right)$$

(1) $l=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$，$\tan\theta=\dfrac{\tan\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}$；

(2) $\tan\theta_{\text{光}}=\dfrac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}{n\beta+\cos\theta_0}$；

(3) 玻璃棒被照亮的长度 $l_{\text{亮}}$ 随时间分段变化：

阶段1（$t\leq t_{\text{停发}}=\dfrac{n}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\dfrac{l_0}{c}$）：$l_{\text{亮}}=\dfrac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct$；

阶段2（$t_{\text{停发}}<t\leq t_{\text{出棒}}=\dfrac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\dfrac{l_0}{c}$）：$l_{\text{亮}}=\dfrac{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}nl_0$；

阶段3（$t_{\text{出棒}}<t\leq t_{\text{离棒}}=\dfrac{2n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\dfrac{l_0}{c}$）：$l_{\text{亮}}=\dfrac{\left[(2n+\beta\cos\theta_0)l_0-\sqrt{1-\beta^2}ct\right]\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}$；

阶段4（$t>t_{\text{离棒}}$）：$l_{\text{亮}}=0$。
